save_attachment_to_disk: save a base64-encoded attachment to disk and return its URL and file size
clear_graphql_cache: clear the GraphQL cache entries for a given session ID
update_graphql_cache: check if an object has changed and update the GraphQL cache with its new state
process_attachments: process a list of attachments into GraphQL-compatible objects with URLs and sizes
get_world_logs_for_graphql: convert a list of agent world logs into GraphQL-compatible log objects with attachments
